profile.headline: Ruby Engineer - Experience in many languages
profile.summary: University of Toronto computer engineering grad interested in industry opportunities, both hardware and software.

positions.title: Synthesis Intern (PEY)
positions.description:
► Performed floor planning, synthesis, and timing closure for IP and SOC blocks
► Utilized tools such as Design Compiler, IC Compiler and Design Vision
► Worked closely with RTL designers to suggest/analyze timing closure related RTL fixes
► Executed Engineering Change Order (ECO) scoping and implementation at netlist level
► Added RTL generation and data visualization features to ASIC design flow (Perl)
► Participated in Synopsys UVM/Assertions workshop
► Utilized Jira quality management software

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
► Developed, produced, and sold an original educational game
► Designed promotional materials and website
► Successfully applied for US trademark (Sr. no. 85689526)
► Led in the preparation for, and the attendance of, GAMA convention in Las Vegas
► Acknowledged and awarded by the Chicago Toy & Game Group and the Tillywig Cooperation.

► Developed iOS version of King of 20 board game (Objective C)
► Utilized Sprite builder, Cocos-2D, and Xcode in development process
► Managed social media accounts for business (facebook.com/Kingof20 - twitter.com/Kof20Game)
► Managed feedback from users.

positions.title: STEM Higher Education Council Intern
positions.description:
► Worked with STEM Higher Education Council (SHEC) projects in planning of National Leaders Summit
► Supported organizations strategic outreach to existing and potential members through research and writing
► Aided in expansion phase and special projects under Million Women Mentors (MWM) Initiative through research, writing and design work
► Served as a liaison to other STEM organizations/institutions and represented company at key events

positions.title: Instrument Petting Zoo/Ticketing Volunteer
positions.description:
► Worked in team of 3 to set-up and manage instrument display
► Worked with 50+ children throughout the day; demonstrating proper instrument technique
► Cared for and monitored delicate instrument pieces (reeds, ligatures, ect.)  
► Engaged with customers and result confusion
► Promoted other DC Jazz events

positions.title: Program Specialist
positions.description:
► Monitored and Supervised 33 North Las Vegas park and field facilities
► Provides customer service for recreation programs including early childhood instruction, sports, seniors, mobile recreation, day camp, fitness centers, and other programs as assigned
► Assured buildings, grounds and physical facilities readiness
► Resolved conflict between coaches/parents and ensured proper use of city equipment
► Maintained and enforced field schedules; resolved eventual conflicts

positions.title: Museum Intern/Volunteer
positions.description:
► Wrote and edited descriptions for museum artifacts; used later in display
► Wrote posts for museum Facebook account
► Conducted research online and through museum archives to ensure historical accuracy of museum materials

positions.title: Dish Washer
positions.description:
► Maintained high standards of customer service during high-volume, fast-paced operations
► Communicated clearly and positively with coworkers and management
► Followed procedures for safe food preparation, assembly, and presentation 
► Assisted management with inventory control and stock ordering
► Resolved complaints promptly and professionally 
► Performed janitorial tasks

positions.title: Computer Assistant
positions.locationName: 3416 North Buffalo Drive, Las Vegas, NV
positions.description:
► Managed the computer use of a team of 3
► Assisting in an office-wide transition from paper-filing to online-filing
► Guided office employees through technological transition
► Utilized and adapted to industry specific technology; ‘Athenahealth’

educations.schoolName: The Washington Center for Internships and Academic Seminars

honors.title: AMD Best Intern Nomination 2018
honors.description: Nominated as top AMD intern for 2018 term by Supervisor and Manager. Advanced to second round of qualifications by AMD Intern Office. One of 15 students (of +100) to advance to second round.
honors.issuer: Issued by Supervisor, Manager, and AMD Intern Office · Aug 2018
